title: Safety Arithmetic: A Framework for Test-time Safety Alignment of Language Models by Steering Parameters and Activations
reasoning: The paper includes a specific evaluation category for 'Philosophy and Ethics' within its datasets (HarmfulQA, NicheHazardQA, and its own NOINTENTEDIT). It benchmarks the model's ability to handle ethical dilemmas, moral relativism, and nihilism, moving beyond a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section by incorporating these topics into its core experimental evaluation.
